ENGLISH FILE
Beginner
2A  Vocabulary
Description
Students practise classroom language
Lesson link
Use this activity before students open their books to start the lesson
Time
10 minutes
Extra material None
Instructions
a Tell SS that you are going to give some
instructions and they must do what you say. The
instructions will either be for the whole class, e.g.
‘Stand up, please’, or for individual SS only, e.g.
‘Jaime and Sara, please stand up.’
b Give out some instructions, such as

Close your books.
_______, close the door.
Open your books.
_______, open the door.
Look at the board, please.
Look at your books.
_______, look at _______.
etc.
c After a few minutes you could ask a student to
take over your role, or you could divide the class
into groups and get each group to choose ‘an
instructor’.
